title: Web search optimization
description: Technical and content checks for pages intended to appear in organic search.

sources.title: Google Search Central, SEO Starter Guide
Google Search Central, How to use Search Console

rules.instruction: Record in the content plan the search intent that each public page serves.
rules.verification: Open the content plan and check that each changed public page has an intent and that no two pages share one.

rules.instruction: Give each public page a descriptive title element and a visible main heading that distinguish it from nearby pages.
rules.verification: Check that the rendered HTML of each changed page has a title element and a main heading, and that no other page in the sitemap uses the same title.

rules.instruction: Link to each public page from a relevant page, with anchor text that describes the destination.
rules.verification: Find the internal link in the rendered HTML and check that it is a crawlable `<a href>` link whose text describes the destination.

rules.instruction: For pages meant to appear in search, review status codes, indexability and canonical targets before publishing. Plan redirects when replacing public URLs.
rules.verification: Inspect representative URLs and redirect targets. After release, use Search Console or the team's approved indexing report to investigate unexpected exclusions.
